scope: All 641 registered navigation body sprites. Prepared image contact sheets were inspected; recipes and source generators were traced. This does not treat galaxy or nebula image/volume layers as planetary discs.
notes: Illustrative curvature is applied to map identifiers and neutral placeholders. It is not measured stellar limb darkening.
Measured or modeled stellar emission and thermal-map palettes retain their existing source treatment.
The 25 comet baselines in capture.json exactly reproduce the old pixels from inventoried retained geometry before changing lighting.
